reviews.text: For transparency I played helped a bit with the play testing on this, but it's an absolute blast. I've sunk many hours into the addicting score chasing of Hex Strikers. If you like incremental games or arcade games or that thrill of seeing numbers climbing higher exponentially, this is a perfect choice. Also it's free, just play it!!
It's a fantastic game. From the very beginning you'll want to keep playing and start another round. It doesn't make sense that it's free.

This game is brilliant, extremely addictive and makes you want to keep playing over and over. It's also got a lovely aesthetic which is very easy on the eyes. Highly recommended, especially since it's free!
Very well made game that runs on linux out of the box! The graphics are fantastic and the game loop is pretty good :D

This one's a bit of a curiousity! @SidFishGames presents Hex Strikers, a game where you build a themepark. You need to create synergy to score but The XP-locked shop upgrade system forces constant cycling so you attempt synergy in an ever-changing environment. Fun. And free! So no reason not to check it out. For more niche curation, follow me at: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/27440015-CSH-Picone/ Want more honest niche & indie reviews? Great game. I'm a huge fan of puzzle games, and the board in this is basically just a massive stack of mini-puzzles. The game has a great dev that updates the game with really nice QOL features occasionally, too. Definitely check this one out.
Pretty simple clicker style hex building roguelike, and when I say simple, I mean simple concept with pretty interesting mechanics. Definitely worth a little of your time since it's free.
Great first game for the devs to put up on steam. Def can sink a good amount of hours into it. Great for a casual session.

免费 有成就 没中文 六边形击手 从单块六边形地块开始，精心布局、逐步扩张版图。每一次击打都能获得代币，可在商店兑换升级道具，完善你的经营策略。 借助冰淇淋、玉米热狗等趣味美食道具加成代币收益，再通过调味辅料进一步提升收益倍率。为击手升级更强力的锤子，成倍拉高奖励回报。 解锁杂耍小丑、单人乐队等全新六边形地块，叠加倍率效果，搭配打出强力连锁组合。 各类六边形地块的摆放位置至关重要，挖掘彼此间的联动增益，最大化刷取分数。 冲击全球排行榜，冲击你的最高分纪录。

These Balatro-roguelike-clones are turning into any other game besides poker. There's chess, slots, scratch offs... Now we got a carnival simulator! These games will see no end. Keep it up! Size: 59MB
Hex Strikers is a carnival-themed game with interesting tile&card-based gameplay. The XP-locked shop upgrade system forces constant cycling so you attempt synergy in an ever-changing environment.
Visual style, animations and sounds are cool, very strategic if you want to min-max. Might be a bit long for some people, as the timing depends more on us due to mix-maxing the numbers.
Hex strikers is an interesting and addicting high-score Incremental management survival game with a circus aesthetic.
